body:
🛒 PremiumShop — The Ultimate Server Shop Experience
Give your players a seamless, fully customizable shopping experience with PremiumShop — the go-to shop plugin for Spigot & Paper servers. Whether you're running a survival economy or a network store, everything is configured through a clean, easy-to-use config.yml.
✨ Features:

Easy Configuration — Set up your entire shop in minutes. Add items, set prices, and define categories without any coding knowledge.
Custom Shop Layouts — Design your shop GUI exactly how you want it. Custom item names, lore, slots and categories fully supported.
Buy & Sell Support — Let players both buy and sell items at configurable prices, keeping your server economy balanced and active.
Multiple Shop Categories — Organize your shop into clean sections like Blocks, Food, Weapons, and more — making it easy for players to find what they need.
Economy Plugin Support — Works seamlessly with Vault & popular economy plugins like EssentialsX Economy.
Permission-Based Access — Lock certain shop categories or items behind permissions, perfect for donor ranks or VIP perks.
Lightweight & Lag-Free — Optimized to run smoothly even on busy servers with dozens of players shopping at once.

⚙️ Perfect for:
Survival servers, RPG worlds, network hubs, or any server looking for a polished and professional in-game shop experience.
